pages.title: b12-anemia — page 2
pages.panel: Labeled anatomy: vitamin B12 & folate absorption
pages.status: 4 rows flagged — all 4 endpoints measured; 3 targets measured, 1 needs placing from source.
pages.lead: No coordinate was given for any row on this page; every endpoint below was read off the artwork and confirmed by sampling the tissue under it. Three of the four faults are the same shape: a badge or leader stops on the DUODENAL/BOWEL tube it happens to overlie rather than on the organ its legend names.

findings.label: ③ marker — legend "Parietal Cells"
findings.now_desc: the badge sits on the pink DUODENAL C-LOOP at the pylorus, sampled (225,132,117) just under it
findings.target_desc: the gastric body/fundus where parietal cells actually sit, sampled (215,97,89)

findings.label: Pancreas  [CHECK]
findings.now_desc: the leader stops at the badge ③ ring on the pink duodenal wall - the orange pancreas does not begin until x≈455, so it is ~24 px short

findings.label: ⑥ marker — legend "Transport" (B12 enters portal blood)  [CHECK]
findings.now_desc: sampled (112,52,48) - the pink BOWEL WALL. The leader runs left from the badge, curves up and dies on the gut
findings.target_desc: the blue portal vein drawn immediately to its left, sampled (22,69,119) - unmistakable against the bowel

findings.label: ⑤ Terminal ileum  [CHECK]
findings.now_desc: the badge sits on the bowel loop descending on the patient’s LEFT (the aorta/IVC pair run at x 430-467, so midline is ~455 and this loop is left of it)
findings.target_desc: the right lower quadrant, where the terminal ileum and cecum belong. PLACE FROM SOURCE - sampling the viewer-left lower quadrant returns background ((0,9,17) at (380,830)), so we could not find a distinctly drawn cecum to put a pixel on

pages.note: Row 1 has a second half the order flags and we confirm by absence: there is NO ④ marker anywhere on the figure, although the legend lists ④ Duodenum. So either the ③ badge is really the missing ④ sitting in the right place with the wrong number, or ④ was dropped. THAT CHANGES THE FIX - if it is a numbering error, renumber the badge rather than moving it, because it is already on the duodenum. Worth one look at the source file before anything is dragged. Rows 1, 2 and 4 are otherwise short, unambiguous moves.
